g.text: F06 access: GUI Save and calculate; CLI prepare/demo. API estimateCost(v, a) also exists: cache cost/a only if v still equals the saved vehicle.
There is no estimate-cost CLI alias or separate cost-only GUI action. Independent check actions do not replace the saved Vehicle.
Same aliases as A; factory = EvaluationStrategyFactory, policy = selected EvaluationStrategy. Field editing alone does not save.
Profile save clears risk/report, not cached cost. Local llmStatus() does not send a request. F04 is Java-only; text ambiguity belongs to F02/F11.
Solid filled arrows: calls; dashed: returns / labelled exception propagation; open: user events. Subframes are separate invocations, not automatic chaining.
